$Comment: Right click: aim the Compactor like a flashlight for as long as the button is down (the animation set's Camera.Pitch block keeps the arm following the look pitch), and compact. Arrakis_Compactor_Compact is the vanilla Charging interaction with one addition: every tick of the hold compacts the sand block under the crosshair (CompactorInteraction). Rule and numbers are data: blocks whose Group is in AllowedGroups, except ExcludedBlocks and ExcludedPrefixes; Range 3; one cycle takes CompactSeconds and gives DropsPerCycle drops; PowerPerSecond; MaxCrack is the share of the block's health shown cracked at the end of a cycle (at most 0.9).
